docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,300.00 FILED BY ZARGA, GABRIELA AS TO DEFENDANT BELTRAN, MARCELINO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-08-2012 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-08-2012 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE AND INTERPRETER TO AUG-30-2012 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT BOTH ASKED FOR SPANISH INTERPRETER AT THE TIME OF THE HEARING TODAY. BOTH PARTIES WERE ASKED TO CHECK IN ROOM 103 IF THEY QUALIFY FOR INTERPRETERS; IF THEY DO NOT QUALIFY FOR INTERPRETERS , THEY ARE BOTH REQUIRED TO BRING THEIR OWN SPANISH INTERPRETER AT THE NEXT HEARING OF 8/30/12 AT 8:30AM. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

APPLICATION FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF ZARGA, GABRIELA ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-30-2012 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO SEP-20-2012 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF, ONLY. PLAINTIFF WAS REPRESENTED BY DANIEL NAVARRO--SPANISH INTERPRETER. SPANISH INTERPRETER ORDERED FOR PLAINTIFF FOR THE NEXT HEARING TODAY.NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE, PER PLAINTIFF. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF, ONLY. MANTI HENRIQUES--SPANISH INTERPRETER WAS PRESENT BUT PLAINTIFF ARRIVED AT 9:00AM BY THEN THE INTERPRETER HAD LEFT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
